cards.title: B01a scope (auth & credentials)
items: Modules: auth, api-key, service-account (~32 routes est.). Grouped endpoint nodes for readability; route-level details and examples in this card.

Auth routes: POST /auth/login, logout, refresh, impersonate, revoke-impersonation, stream-ticket; GET /auth/me; register controller POST /auth/register, /auth/register/verify; admin impersonation POST /admin/users/:id/impersonate.
SSO/SAML routes: POST /auth/sso/start, GET /auth/sso/callback, GET /auth/sso/saml/:tenantKey/metadata, POST /auth/sso/saml/:tenantKey/start, POST /auth/sso/saml/:tenantKey/acs.

API keys: GET/POST /admin/api-keys, GET scopes, GET/PATCH/DELETE /:id, POST /:id/revoke, POST /:id/rotate, GET /:id/usage (9 routes). Service accounts: GET scopes, POST/GET /admin/service-accounts, GET/PATCH/DELETE /:id, POST /:id/rotate, plus POST /auth/service-token exchange.

cards.title: Example input/output (key flows)
items: Login (POST /auth/login): input credentials/tenant context per Auth DTO; output session/JWT/refresh tokens or auth challenge (verify DTO). Refresh/stream-ticket return new scoped credentials.

API key create (POST /admin/api-keys): input CreateApiKeyRequest (name/scopes/expiry etc.); output CreateApiKeyResponse {apiKey, rawKey} — raw key returned once. Update/revoke/rotate enforce ownership/scope-ceiling rules noted in controller.

Service-token exchange (POST /auth/service-token): input ServiceAccountTokenRequest (client id/secret); output ServiceAccountTokenResponse with opaque bearer token (default ~15 min), presented via X-Service-Account-Token. Unknown client/bad secret indistinguishable (401); rate limited.
SSO/SAML: start routes redirect/initiate provider flow; callback/ACS complete identity exchange and issue local session. Exact payloads depend on IdP config.

cards.title: Evidence and limitations
items: Repo: https://github.com/ArcaAI/project-hope.git @ 8cb2e5e8e6bbddf5ee7c676782ebb5ad683c23a0. Controller/service sources verified in local tree.

Downstreams are represented at architecture level: external IdP for SSO/SAML, token/session/credential state (service-token notes Redis delete for revocation; JWT/refresh/stream-ticket paths exist), Postgres/Prisma for identity records. Deepen internal service call chains in follow-up passes.

Limitations: endpoint-group nodes (not 1:1 endpoint boxes) for readability; example I/O summarized from controller contracts/DTO names; exact DTO schemas and all auth edge cases should be confirmed against OpenAPI/tests if strict per-endpoint examples are required.
